gloss: out of fashion; behind the times

definitions.gloss: out of fashion; outdated; behind the times
definitions.explanation: Something that was once trendy but is no longer in style.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れだ。
examples.english: That design is out of fashion.

examples.japanese: {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}われる→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: If you wear outdated clothes, people will laugh at you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勧|すす}める→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The fashion that parents recommend is often out of date.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧ (trend, fashion) + ⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧ (delay, falling behind). Used as a noun or as a no-adjective to describe things or people that are behind current trends. Can apply to fashion, technology, ideas, or culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: outdated clothing
- {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go out of fashion
- {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: outdated way of thinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時代遅|じだいおく}れ→時代遅れ：12719_jidaiokure⟧: behind the times — broader; emphasizes being out of step with the era, not just fashion
- ダサい: uncool; lame — casual slang; a subjective judgment of style rather than being literally behind trends
- {古臭|ふるくさ}い: old-fashioned; musty — emphasizes something feeling old and stale
